paths.path: ~/.config/bsnes/settings.bml ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bsnes/settings.bml; an existing settings.bml beside the executable or in user data is preferred). Controller mappings are BML keys under each port/device mapping path; values are semicolon-separated assignments in device-id/group/input[/qualifier] form, where qualifiers include Lo, Hi, and Rumble.
Beside the loaded ROM by default; the Settings > Paths > Saves directory overrides this. Save path keys are derived from the ROM path and extension.
paths.naming: SNES cartridge RAM: <ROM basename>.srm; RTC: <ROM basename>.rtc; download RAM: <ROM basename>.psr. Game Boy support in this desktop target uses <ROM basename>.sav. Co-processor RAM uses the .srm path.

paths.path: Beside the loaded ROM by default as a ZIP archive; the Settings > Paths > States directory overrides this. Directory-style higan games use a bsnes/states/ directory inside the game folder.
paths.naming: ROM-file games: <ROM basename>.bsz ZIP containing <state name>.bst members, including Quick/Slot 1..9.bst, Quick/Undo.bst and Quick/Redo.bst. Directory-style games: bsnes/states/<state name>.bst.

paths.path: Firmware files are looked up under the application Firmware/ resource directory (or its user-data override) by manifest identifier. bsnes has no one universal BIOS file; ordinary SNES games need none, while optional co-processor/boot ROMs are manifest-declared.
paths.naming: Exact source-derived names are <lowercase manifest identifier>.program.rom, <lowercase manifest identifier>.data.rom, or <lowercase manifest identifier>.boot.rom (architectures ARM6, HG51BS169, uPD7725, uPD96050, LR35902). No canonical checksum is published by this target source for these external files; built-in firmware blobs are accepted for recognized sizes. Do not infer a BIOS filename when a manifest identifier is absent.

linux.notes: Native Linux desktop target. bsnes stores settings under userSettings (~/.config) but game saves/states default beside ROM files unless Paths overrides are set.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/dev.bsnes.bsnes/config/bsnes/settings.bml under standard Flatpak XDG_CONFIG_HOME; BML controller mapping keys and values use the same device-id/group/input[/qualifier] semicolon syntax as native bsnes.
Beside the loaded ROM when the sandbox grants access, or in configured Paths/Saves; save names remain <ROM basename>.srm/.rtc/.psr (and .sav for Game Boy).
paths.naming: Same native bsnes extensions: .srm, .rtc, .psr, and .sav as applicable.

paths.path: Beside the ROM as <ROM basename>.bsz, or under configured Paths/States; external ROM access requires Flatpak filesystem permission.
paths.naming: ZIP archive with .bst members (Quick/Slot 1..9, Quick/Undo, Quick/Redo); directory-style games use bsnes/states/*.bst.

paths.path: Firmware/ resource directory or user override in the sandbox; manifest identifiers determine names and external firmware is not assigned a universal checksum by bsnes.
paths.naming: <lowercase manifest identifier>.program.rom/.data.rom/.boot.rom for optional co-processor/boot firmware; ordinary SNES software needs no BIOS.

linux-flatpak.notes: Community Flatpak provenance; package identity and sandbox roots are recorded, but the package is not an upstream bsnes distribution.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/bsnes/settings.bml (Path::userSettings on macOS). Controller mappings are BML mapping keys with semicolon-separated device-id/group/input[/Lo|Hi|Rumble] values.
Beside the loaded ROM by default, or under Settings > Paths > Saves.
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.srm for cartridge RAM, .rtc for time, .psr for download RAM, and .sav for Game Boy RAM; no external firmware is implied by save files.

paths.path: Beside the loaded ROM as <ROM basename>.bsz by default, or under Paths > States; directory-style games use game-folder bsnes/states/.
paths.naming: ZIP archive .bsz containing .bst state members, including Quick/Slot 1..9, Quick/Undo and Quick/Redo; directory-style state files are .bst.

paths.path: Firmware/ resource directory or user override. Ordinary SNES games require no BIOS; optional manifest-declared co-processor and boot ROMs use generated names.
paths.naming: <lowercase manifest identifier>.program.rom/.data.rom/.boot.rom; no canonical external checksum is declared by this source target.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\bsnes\settings.bml (Path::userSettings on Windows; an existing settings.bml beside the executable or in user data is preferred). Controller mappings are BML mapping keys with semicolon-separated device-id/group/input[/Lo|Hi|Rumble] values.
Beside the loaded ROM by default, or under configured Paths/Saves.
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.srm, .rtc, .psr, or .sav depending on the loaded system and memory type.

paths.path: Beside the loaded ROM as <ROM basename>.bsz by default, or under configured Paths/States; directory-style games use bsnes/states/.
paths.naming: ZIP .bsz containing .bst state members (Quick/Slot 1..9, Quick/Undo, Quick/Redo); directory-style games use individual .bst files.

paths.path: Firmware/ resource directory or user override; ordinary SNES games need no BIOS, and optional firmware is resolved from manifest identifiers.
paths.naming: <lowercase manifest identifier>.program.rom/.data.rom/.boot.rom; no canonical checksum for external firmware is declared by this source.
